title: CtlGatewayRenderResponse
description: `POST /v1/gateway/render`: render the NEXT gateway generation from the current registry into a scratch dir and diff it against the published one. Nothing is published; a viewer may call it. `sha256` is over the concatenated rendered files in path order and is the value `gateway/apply` pins in its plan so that what gets published is what was previewed.

generation.description: The generation number the render WOULD be published as.

path.description: Path relative to the generation dir, e.g. `conf.d/05-tenants.generated.conf`.

diff.description: Unified diff against the published generation (empty string when unchanged; a whole-file addition when new). Rendered config never contains secrets, so this is unredacted.
